title: AquaVale: Synthetic water utility corpus for measuring disclosure by internal AI assistants
description: A fictional water and wastewater utility corpus: network, SCADA and fault records derived from open benchmark data (KY10, BATADAL, BattLeDIM); synthetic customer and consumption data; a canary dictionary, 25 gold-labelled pilot questions and measurement scripts. Contains no real person or real infrastructure information. Version 1.1.0 translates the whole corpus to English.
